probes.stdout:
Usage: scip-java [<options>] <command> [<args>]...

  scip-java: index Java/Kotlin codebases into SCIP.

Options:
  -v, --version  Show the version and exit
  -h, --help     Show this message and exit

Commands:
  index      Automatically generate an SCIP index in the current working
             directory.
  aggregate  Aggregates per-source SCIP shards into a single SCIP index file.
  snapshot   Generates annotated snapshots for each `*.scip` file in the given
             target roots.

Usage: scip-java index [<options>] [<buildcommand>]...

  Automatically generate an SCIP index in the current working directory.

Options:
  --output=<path>                The path where to generate the SCIP index.
  --targetroot=<path>            The directory where to generate SCIP files.
                                 Defaults to a build-specific path. For
                                 example, the default value for Gradle is
                                 'build/scip-targetroot' and for Maven it's
                                 'target/scip-targetroot'.
  --build-tool=<gradle>          Explicitly specify which build tool to use. By
                                 default, the build tool is automatically
                                 detected. Use this flag if the automatic build
                                 tool detection is not working correctly.
  --cleanup, --no-cleanup / --no-cleanup
                                 Whether to remove generated temporary files on
                                 exit.
  --scip-ignored-javac-option-prefixes=<text>
                                 List of Java compiler option prefixes that
                                 should be excluded from compilation during
                                 indexing. This flag is only used when indexing
                                 via scip-java.json files or Bazel.
  --scip-ignored-annotation-processors=<text>
                                 List of fully qualified annotation processors
                                 that should be ignored when indexing a
                                 codebase. This flag is only used when indexing
                                 via scip-java.json files or Bazel.
  --scip-config=<path>           Path to a scip-java.json file with build
                                 configuration. By default, the path
                                 scip-java.json is used.
  --bazel-scip-java-binary=<text>
                                 Optional path to a `scip-java` binary.
                                 Required to index a Bazel codebase.
  --bazel-aspect=<path>          Relative path to a Bazel aspect file with an
                                 aspect named 'scip_java_aspect'.
  --bazel-overwrite-aspect-file  If true, overwrites the existing Bazel aspect
                                 file (if any).
  --bazel-autorun-sandbox-command, --no-bazel-autorun-sandbox-command /
--no-bazel-autorun-sandbox-command
                                 If true, automatically tries to extract the
                                 printed out sandbox command and re-run the
                                 command to reveal the underlying problem.
  -h, --help                     Show this message and exit

Arguments:
  <buildcommand>  Optional. The build command to use to compile all sources.
                  Defaults to a build-specific command.
probes.interpretation: Help documents a scip-java.json build-configuration path and says the optional buildcommand compiles sources and defaults to a build-specific command. It does not confirm a static/prebuilt-input mode that avoids project scripts; no index was run.
